🌿 Pune Cooler Routes: Master Capstone Report

A Comprehensive 14-Day Research Sprint in Urban Microclimate & Pedestrian Navigation

📍 Pune, Maharashtra, India 🚶 3,971 Nodes • 10,414 Edges ☀️ pybdshadow + OSM Tree Canopy ⏱️ Generated: 2026-10-18 11:35

1. Executive Summary & Impact

Pune Cooler Routes is a full-stack, research-backed pedestrian navigation platform engineered to protect pedestrians from extreme urban heat stress in Pune's core urban corridor (Kothrud, Karve Road, Deccan Gymkhana, and Fergusson College Road). Over a 14-day intensive development lifecycle, the system evolved from raw OpenStreetMap geometries into a state-of-the-art multi-environmental routing engine integrating solar shadows, tree canopies, time-marching sun trajectories, sidewalk safety, biometeorological heat strain, topographic slope, clean-air corridors, and real-time field navigation.

+14.2% Average Shade Gain
-123 kJ Solar Energy Avoided
-65 mL Sweat Loss Saved
-35% Exhaust Exposure Drop
100% Test Pass Rate
